successCriteria.description: A single shared UniqueConstraintError class exists under src/shared and is the only unique-violation error class in the codebase; its constructor is (code: string, message: string) with code required and no default value.
The employee repository's unique-violation throw sites emit code DUPLICATE_EMPLOYEE and the policy repository's emit DUPLICATE_POLICY, preserving the existing codes exactly.
Existing employee and policy error/repository unit tests continue to pass with the emitted codes DUPLICATE_EMPLOYEE and DUPLICATE_POLICY unchanged.

A single shared RepositoryError base class exists under src/shared, and the module-specific NotFoundError classes (EmployeeNotFoundError, PolicyNotFoundError) extend it while remaining in their own modules.

constraints: The shared UniqueConstraintError must NOT hardcode any code and must NOT provide a default value for code; code is a required constructor argument supplied by the caller.
Each module's unique-constraint code must be defined as a named constant (SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE) with one definition per module, not a bare string literal at the throw site.
Do not add a second unique-violation error class anywhere; every future module reuses the single shared UniqueConstraintError and passes its own DUPLICATE_<ENTITY> constant.
Cross-module imports of the shared error classes must go through the shared module's public entry point (index.ts), never a deep file path.
outOfScope: Moving or changing EmployeeNotFoundError and PolicyNotFoundError — they remain module-specific and are not relocated to shared.
Changing any emitted machine code — DUPLICATE_EMPLOYEE and DUPLICATE_POLICY are preserved exactly; no generic DUPLICATE_RESOURCE code.
Adding a default value for the code argument or a second unique-violation error class.

entityInvariants.invariant: A single shared class; constructor (code, message) with code required and no default; carries no module-specific knowledge; its code field is populated from the caller-supplied argument.
A single shared base error class extending Error with a stable machine code field; module-specific NotFoundError classes extend it and remain in their own modules.
Remains in the employee module; extends the shared RepositoryError; preserves code EMPLOYEE_NOT_FOUND.
Remains in the policy module; extends the shared RepositoryError; preserves code POLICY_NOT_FOUND.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: The shared UniqueConstraintError and RepositoryError must match the error-shape contract { error: string; code: string } with a stable machine code in SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE.
The employee repository's unique-violation throw sites must emit code DUPLICATE_EMPLOYEE, matching the existing employee.repository.ts behaviour.
The policy repository's unique-violation throw sites must emit code DUPLICATE_POLICY, matching the existing policy.repository.ts behaviour.
The shared error classes must be importable through the shared module's public entry point, consistent with the module dependency rule that modules import only via index.ts.
